relevance_note: Case report of a male index case with a LAMP2 variant and Danon disease: 'an intronic splice donor variant in intron 2 of the LAMP2 gene (c.183+2T>C, Figure 3)', plus his mother found to be a carrier.
method_note: Read the full text by hand; a script only assembled the JSON. Four people in scope: index case II:1 and relatives I:1 (father), I:2 (mother, LAMP2 carrier) and II:2 (sibling, sex not stated), labelled with the paper's pedigree labels. The mother's variant row uses c.183+2T>C because the paper calls her 'a carrier of the LAMP2 mutation' right after describing the proband's c.183+2T>C; her zygosity, type, pathogenicity and inheritance are left not reported. The father is said to have been tested only implicitly ('Cascade genetic testing of the parents'); no explicit negative result is printed, so no variant row for him. The sibling's genetic testing is not stated. Proband zygosity left not reported (not stated). Proband age 16 recorded as age at last evaluation/time of report; no explicit age at diagnosis or onset. Normal labs ('Routine hematology, autoimmune screen, ... were normal') recorded per D-27: elevated ACE and reduced alpha-galactosidase excluded; routine hematology, autoimmune screen and electrophoretogram are whole investigations, recorded as written ('abnormal ...') and exclude nothing more specific. Relatives' 'no clinical evidence of cardiomyopathy' recorded as an excluded feature but not used to exclude any narrower checklist item. Pedigree symbols (Figure 1A, 'N' = normal clinical screening) are in a figure, not used. Table 1 is a generic Danon vs HCM comparison, not patient data. Pre-excitation not mentioned for the proband's ECG, so not reported. No contradictions found.
